description_short: A remastered version of the portable Persona 3 experience with two protagonist routes, Tartarus exploration and calendar-based social RPG systems.
description_ar: تنتقل إلى مدرسة Gekkoukan وتكتشف الساعة المظلمة المخفية عن بقية العالم. تنضم إلى فريق SEES، وتصعد برج Tartarus، وتبني Social Links، وتدمج الـPersona، مع إمكانية تجربة القصة عبر بطل أو بطلة بما يغيّر عددًا من العلاقات والمشاهد.

videos.title: Persona 3 Portable & Persona 4 Golden — Available Now on Nintendo Switch

nintendoNotes:
Nintendo AU confirms Nintendo Switch 2 backward compatibility, 7.1 GB size, TV/Tabletop/Handheld modes, Save Data Cloud, and both Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Supplier selection supplied by user: Simplified Chinese. Regular / 普通版 ¥7.78 (pre-discount ¥11); Standard / 标准版 ¥55.8 (pre-discount ¥60). Converted costs: Regular 1,500 IQD; Standard 12,250 IQD. Supplier stock is marked 即将售罄 / near sold out; this is preserved as low_supplier_stock while store infinite-stock behavior remains enabled by the import rule.

Only two supplier variants exist, so no supplier DLC product types are created.
switch2Features: Faster loading may occur through backward compatibility

gameplayPillars.title: Climb Tartarus
gameplayPillars.description: Explore randomized floors of Tartarus, manage party resources and exploit elemental weaknesses in turn-based combat.

gameplayPillars.title: Live the School Year
gameplayPillars.description: Balance school days, social activities and Social Links across a calendar while preparing for major lunar events.

gameplayPillars.title: Choose Your Protagonist
gameplayPillars.description: Choose the male or female protagonist for distinct social routes, relationships and presentation differences.

gameplayPillars.title: Develop Social Links
gameplayPillars.description: Use limited calendar time to deepen Social Links, strengthen Persona fusion and experience route-specific character stories.

worldSummary: Modern-day Iwatodai appears ordinary until the Dark Hour transforms the city. Tartarus rises during this hidden hour and Shadows threaten people who cannot perceive what is happening.

storyChapters.title: The Dark Hour
storyChapters.body: The protagonist transfers to Gekkoukan High and experiences the Dark Hour before awakening the power of Persona.

storyChapters.title: SEES and Tartarus
storyChapters.body: SEES explores Tartarus and battles Shadows while investigating the origin and purpose of the Dark Hour.

storyChapters.title: The Truth Behind the Shadows
storyChapters.body: The group’s relationships and discoveries deepen as the consequences of the Dark Hour become increasingly personal.

storyChapters.title: The Final Months
storyChapters.body: The final months force SEES to confront the meaning of the Dark Hour and the choices surrounding the fate awaiting the world.

features: Two protagonist routes with different social experiences
perfNotes: Nintendo Life describes the Switch version as rock-solid 60 fps. NintendoGalaxy provides a Switch frame-rate test recorded at 1080p/60 output, and Sega-Mag also reports 1080p/60 on Switch. Internal rendering resolution is not independently asserted beyond output-class reporting.

handheld.notes: Rock-solid 60 fps in handheld review coverage. Portable output is represented conservatively as 720p-class; internal render resolution is not claimed.

tv.notes: 60 fps. 1080p output is reported by technical/review sources.

devicePerformance.performanceNotes: 60 fps is the high-confidence performance point. Resolution fields describe reported output rather than an undocumented internal render target.

storageNotes: Nintendo AU lists a 7.1 GB game file on Switch and on Switch 2 through compatibility.

faq.q: Does Persona 3 Portable support Chinese on Switch?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo AU lists Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional) among the supported languages.

faq.q: Does Persona 3 Portable work on Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists Nintendo Switch 2 compatibility as supported, through backward compatibility rather than a native Switch 2 version.
No. It is a single-player RPG; Nintendo lists one local player.

faq.q: What does the supplier stock warning mean?
faq.a: The supplier marked the listing 即将售罄, meaning near sold out. The import file preserves that supplier condition as low_supplier_stock even though the storefront account product uses infinite-stock behavior by default.
